title: Extra Seat Charge Amounts on Paloma Business Accounts
content:
**Users charged.** The users charged on a Paloma Business account are the users added in the month before the day the charge is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day one month earlier up to and including that day, but never more than the active users beyond the plan's included seats, the active users being the owner plus every user added less every user removed.

**Amount.** The extra seat charge is the number of users charged times the plan's extra seat fee, charged in full for the billing period and rounded half up to the cent.

### Definitions restated

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Active users | 1 for the owner, plus every user added, less every user removed |
| Active users beyond the included seats | Active users less the plan's included seats, and no fewer than zero |
| Users added in the month | Users added from the day after the same calendar day one month earlier through the day the charge is worked out |
| Users charged | The users added in the month, but never more than the active users beyond the included seats |
| Extra seat charge | Users charged multiplied by the plan's extra seat fee, in full for the period, rounded half up to the cent |

### Worked figure (hypothetical Paloma Business Growth account: 5 included seats, extra seat fee 9.00 USD)

1. The owner plus 7 users added and 1 removed: 7 active users, 2 beyond the 5 included seats.
2. Charge worked out on 18 October: users added from 19 September through 18 October: 3.
3. Users charged: 3, but never more than 2, so 2.
4. Extra seat charge: 2 multiplied by 9.00, that is 18.00 USD.

A second figure: if only 1 user had been added in the month, the users charged would be 1 and the charge 9.00 USD.
